### Security

- sqlx 0.9.1, which bundles a fixed SQLite (libsqlite3-sys 0.40), for RUSTSEC-2026-0459. The advisory is no longer ignored.

### Notes

- Building kaze yourself now needs Rust 1.94 or newer. The Docker image and the Nix flake already use a newer toolchain.
- Nothing else changed since 0.9.0; see its notes for signing in and OIDC.
